variable: dropsample (whether to remove the sample for failing quality control)
negativecontrolpc1 (negative control principal component 1 for batch correction)
negativecontrolpc2 (negative control principal component 2 for batch correction)
negativecontrolpc3 (negative control principal component 3 for batch correction)
negativecontrolpc4 (negative control principal component 4 for batch correction)
predictedsex (sex predicted by sex chromosome probes)
bestqc (best sample to use when more than 1 array were run on the same subject/brnum)
comp_es (composition estimates for embryonic stem cells (escs)
comp_npc (composition estimates for neural progenitor cells (npcs)
comp_da_neuron (composition estimates for dopamine neurons derived from escs)
comp_neun_pos (composition estimates for adult cortex-derived neuronal cells)
comp_neun_neg(composition estimates for adult cortex-derived non-neuronal cells)
